description: Implement the auth module: user table DDL generation, user CRUD (create/find/verify), session cookie integration (HMAC signing into session.nim), auth middleware that populates ctx.currentUser, and the built-in signup/login/logout route handlers. Wire auth enforcement into server.nim replacing the Phase 3 no-op.
steps: Create src/doot/auth.nim - the main auth module that ties everything together. It should import crypto, session, db_types, query, and db_connector/db_sqlite.
In auth.nim, define AuthConfig type: model name, roles seq, emailVerification bool, sessionSecret string, sessionExpiry (Duration, default 14 days).

In auth.nim, define the UserTable DDL constant: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT DEFAULT '', email_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))). Add a unique index on email.
In auth.nim, implement proc initAuth*(db: DbConn, config: AuthConfig): creates users table and sessions table (_sessions) if they don't exist.

In auth.nim, implement proc createUser*(db: DbConn, email: string, password: string, role: string = ''): DbResult - validates email uniqueness, hashes password with hashPassword from crypto.nim, inserts row, returns result.
In auth.nim, implement proc findUserByEmail*(db: DbConn, email: string): Row (or nil) - SELECT from users WHERE email = ?.
In auth.nim, implement proc findUserById*(db: DbConn, id: int64): Row (or nil) - SELECT from users WHERE id = ?.

In auth.nim, implement proc authenticateUser*(db: DbConn, email: string, password: string): Row (or nil) - looks up user by email, verifies password with verifyPassword from crypto.nim, returns user Row or nil.

In auth.nim, implement proc createSession*(store: SessionStore, userId: int64, secret: string, expiresInDays: int = 14): string - creates a session in the DB with expiry, returns the signed cookie value (sessionId.hmac).
In auth.nim, implement proc destroySession*(store: SessionStore, cookie: string, secret: string) - verifies cookie signature, deletes session from DB.

In auth.nim, implement proc loadUserFromCookie*(db: DbConn, store: SessionStore, cookie: string, secret: string): Row (or nil) - verifies cookie HMAC, loads session, checks expiry, loads user by session.userId, returns user Row or nil.
Update src/doot/session.nim: add proc cleanupExpiredSessions*(store: SessionStore) that DELETEs sessions where expires_at < datetime('now').

Update src/doot/server.nim: wire session cookie reading into handleRequest. Before handler execution: read 'doot_session' cookie from request headers, call loadUserFromCookie to populate ctx.currentUser. After handler execution: if a Set-Cookie was generated (new session), include it in the response headers.

Update src/doot/server.nim: replace the auth enforcement no-op (the 'discard' block) with real enforcement: if routeMatch.route.authRequired and ctx.currentUser is nil, return 401 response. If routeMatch.route.roleName is non-empty and ctx.currentUser.role != roleName, return 403 response.

In auth.nim, implement the three built-in route handlers as procs that can be registered on a DootServer: handleSignup (reads email+password from ctx.form, creates user, creates session, returns redirect with Set-Cookie), handleLogin (reads email+password from ctx.form, authenticates, creates session, returns redirect with Set-Cookie), handleLogout (reads cookie, destroys session, returns redirect with Set-Cookie clearing the cookie).
In auth.nim, implement proc registerAuthRoutes*(server: DootServer, db: DbConn, config: AuthConfig) - registers POST /signup, POST /login, POST /logout as public routes with the built-in handlers.

Add comprehensive tests to tests/test_auth.nim: test user creation (happy path, duplicate email), test authentication (correct/wrong password), test session creation and cookie signing, test loadUserFromCookie (valid session, expired session, tampered cookie), test auth enforcement (required route returns 401 without session, public route returns 200, role check returns 403), test signup/login/logout handler flows, test cleanup of expired sessions.
acceptance_criteria: createUser inserts a user with hashed password (not plaintext) and returns ok result
createUser returns error for duplicate email
authenticateUser returns user Row for correct credentials and nil for wrong password
createSession stores a session in SQLite and returns a signed cookie string
destroySession removes the session from the database
loadUserFromCookie returns user for valid session cookie and nil for tampered/expired cookies
Server returns 401 for auth:required routes when no session cookie is present
Server returns 200 for auth:public routes without session cookie
Server returns 403 when user role does not match route role requirement
POST /signup creates a user and returns Set-Cookie header
POST /login with valid credentials returns Set-Cookie header
ctx.currentUser is populated when valid session exists
All tests pass: nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_auth.nim

export PATH="/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_server_e2e.nim

findings: All 96 tests pass (36 crypto + 60 auth). The registerAuthRoutes proc must live in server.nim (not auth.nim) to avoid circular dependency since auth.nim cannot import server.nim. With auto type parameter, Nim cannot resolve registerRoute from inside auth.nim because the proc is not visible there. HttpClient follows redirects by default - E2E tests must use maxRedirects=0 when testing POST endpoints that return 302. The db_connector/db_sqlite module exports a Row type (seq[string]) that conflicts with db_types.Row - use 'import db_connector/db_sqlite except Row' to resolve. Auth enforcement is gated by server.authEnabled flag so existing tests with authEnabled=false continue to work without session cookies.
